description: 航（wataru）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 航

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. Wataru, an eleven year old frail sick boy, about five heads tall, thin and small: messy dark hair with a cowlick, sallow pale skin, hollow cheeks, dark circles, an oversized faded mint-green hospital-style pajama set with a worn collar and mismatched buttons, a thin grey knitted cardigan slipping off one shoulder, white socks with a hole, a small bandage on the wrist. Empty hands. Uneven rough hand-inked linework with varied line weight, gritty grime and fabric wrinkles, slightly asymmetrical, lived-in and worn, matte not glossy, not airbrushed, no idealized perfect face.
